newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean import prices rise 8.7 pct yr/yr in June.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean import prices rise 8.7 pct yr/yr in June.

text.p: South Korean import prices rose 8.7 percent in June from a year earlier and export prices were up 9.4 percent, both in terms of won, the central Bank of Korea said on Monday.
Compared with the previous month, import prices were up 0.1 percent while export prices remained unchanged, a Bank of Korea report said.
In June, import prices for raw materials and capital goods rose by 9.1 percent and 7.0 percent respectively from a year ago while those for consumer goods gained 8.5 percent.
Export prices of industrial goods went up 9.9 percent, and for mining goods 12.9 percent. But export prices for farm, forestry and fishery products fell by 0.5 percent.
The import prices were based on cost, insurance and freight (CIF) while export prices were free on board (FOB).
